disrespectfully: He spoke disrespectfully to the teacher and was asked to leave the room.
他跟老师说话很无礼，被要求离开教室。
Regan: In the play, Regan joins her sister in treating their old father very badly.
在剧中，里根和姐姐一起虐待年迈的父亲。
Goneril: Goneril tells her father that she loves him more than words can express.
贡纳莉告诉父亲，她爱他胜过千言万语。
Cordelia: Unlike her sisters, Cordelia refuses to flatter her father with empty words.
与姐姐们不同，科迪莉亚拒绝用空洞的话语奉承父亲。
Albany: The Duke of Albany slowly realizes how cruel his wife has become.
奥尔巴尼公爵渐渐意识到他的妻子变得多么残忍。
Cornwall: Cornwall is punished for his cruelty when his own servant turns against him.
康沃尔因残暴而受到惩罚，连自己的仆人都起来反抗他。
Kent: Kent remains loyal to the old king even after he is sent away.
肯特即使被放逐，仍然忠于年老的国王。
hand over: The old manager will hand over his job to his son at the end of this year.
老经理将在今年年底把工作移交给他的儿子。
hear out: Please hear out the whole story before you make your decision.
在你做决定之前，请听完整个故事。
flattery: She saw through his flattery and knew he only wanted her help.
她看穿了他的奉承，知道他只是想要她的帮助。
beyond question: His honesty is beyond question; everyone in the office trusts him completely.
他的诚实毋庸置疑，办公室里的每个人都完全信任他。
speak out: More people should speak out when they see something wrong at school.
看到学校里不对的事情时，应该有更多人大胆说出来。
pack up: Please pack up your toys before you go to bed tonight.
今晚睡觉前请把你的玩具收拾好。
be fond of: It is natural to be fond of people who are always kind to you.
喜欢那些一直对你友善的人是很自然的事。
greed: His greed for money made him lose many good friends over the years.
他对金钱的贪婪使他在这些年里失去了许多好朋友。
strorage: The old house has a large strorage room for tools and winter clothes.
这座老房子有一间大储藏室，用来放工具和冬衣。
Stratford-on-Avon: Many tourists visit Stratford-on-Avon every year to see where Shakespeare was born.
每年许多游客到埃文河畔斯特拉特福镇参观莎士比亚的出生地。
make a name: She worked hard for many years to make a name in the fashion world.
她多年来努力工作，想在时装界出名。
armchair: After dinner, my father sat in his armchair and read the evening paper.
晚饭后，父亲坐在扶手椅上读晚报。
Maryann Jines: Maryann Jines was surprised to receive a letter from her old college friend.
玛丽安·琼斯收到大学老朋友的来信，感到很惊讶。
Martin Luther King Jr. believed that people should be judged by their character.
马丁·路德·金认为，评价一个人应该看他的品格。
seize on: Reporters always seize on any small mistake that a famous person makes.
记者们总会抓住名人犯的任何小错大做文章。
collision course: The two companies are on a collision course over the new technology.
两家公司因新技术问题正走向正面冲突。
Walter Cunningham: Walter Cunningham refused the money because he believed he should pay his own way.
沃尔特·坎宁安拒绝了那笔钱，因为他认为自己应该自食其力。
live out: He left his hometown to live out his dream of becoming a musician.
他离开家乡，去实现成为音乐家的梦想。
in detail: The teacher explained the new grammar rules in detail so that everyone understood.
老师详细讲解了新的语法规则，让每个人都听懂了。
tend to: Children tend to copy the behavior of their parents without knowing it.
孩子们往往会在不知不觉中模仿父母的行为。
tend to do sth: The pattern “tend to do sth” means that people often do something.
“tend to do sth（往往会做某事）”这一句型表示人们常会做某事。
Agnes Grey: Agnes Grey tells the story of a young governess and her difficult life.
《艾格妮斯·格雷》讲述了一位年轻家庭教师艰难生活的故事。
Jane Austin: Jane Austin is remembered as one of the most popular English novelists.
简·奥斯丁作为最受欢迎的英国小说家之一被人们铭记。
Charlotte Bronte: Charlotte Bronte began writing stories when she was only a young girl at home.
夏洛蒂·勃朗特还是个小姑娘时就开始在家里写故事了。
Tess of d’Urbevilles: Tess of d’Urbevilles is one of the most famous novels written by Thomas Hardy.
《德伯家的苔丝》是托马斯·哈代最著名的小说之一。
Wuthering Heights: Wuthering Heights is a sad love story set on the windy northern moors.
《呼啸山庄》是一个以多风的北部荒原为背景的悲剧爱情故事。
Margaret Mitchell: Margaret Mitchell spent nearly ten years writing her only novel about the American South.
玛格丽特·米切尔花了近十年时间写她唯一一部关于美国南方的小说。
Rudyard Kipling: Rudyard Kipling won the Nobel Prize and wrote stories that children still love today.
拉迪亚德·吉普林获得了诺贝尔奖，他写的故事至今仍受孩子们喜爱。
in force: The new traffic rules have been in force since the first day of March.
新的交通规则自三月一日开始实施。
get round: She managed to get round the problem by asking a friend for help.
她通过请朋友帮忙，顺利解决了这个问题。
George Eliot: George Eliot was a woman writer who used a man's name in her work.
乔治·艾略特是一位在作品中使用男性名字的女作家。
under the name of: She published many of her early poems under the name of a famous writer.
她早年发表的许多诗都是用一位著名作家的名字发表的。
see through: I can easily see through his excuses because he tells the same story every time.
我能轻易识破他的借口，因为他每次都讲同样的故事。
